settings.title: The Story Behind The Sayings
settings.text_1: Every saying on every shirt comes from a real moment, a real journey. A Hayley Original was born from 10 years of truth, loss, love and everything in between.
settings.text_2: No grey areas. Just real words from a real life.

settings.shipping_text_1: 5–10 business days. Orders are printed and dispatched within 3–5 days via Printful. Free shipping on orders over $80 AUD.
settings.shipping_text_2: 2–4 business days. Available at checkout. Because sometimes you need it now.
settings.shipping_text_3: We ship everywhere. Fulfilled from the Printful facility closest to you. Customs and duties may apply.
settings.returns_text: Print defects, wrong size, or damaged item? Contact us within 14 days and we'll reprint or refund. No change-of-mind returns — every item is made to order.
settings.sizing_intro: All measurements in centimetres. When in doubt, size up — the relaxed fit is intentional. Garments are Bella+Canvas 3001, 180gsm unisex tee.
settings.sizing_note: Still unsure? Email us at designer@ahayleyoriginal.com and we'll help you find your size.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Standard 5–10 business days from production. Express 2–4 days available at checkout.

settings.question: Are items printed on demand?
settings.answer: Yes — every item is made when you order it via Printful. No dead stock, no waste, printed fresh for you.

settings.question: Can I return or exchange?
settings.answer: Print defects, wrong items or damage — contact us within 14 days and we'll reprint or refund. No change-of-mind returns as items are made to order.

settings.question: What fabric are the shirts?
settings.answer: Bella+Canvas 3001 unisex jersey. 100% Airlume combed and ring-spun cotton, 180gsm. Pre-shrunk, retail fit.

settings.question: How do I wash my shirt?
settings.answer: Cold wash inside out. Tumble dry low or air dry. Don't iron directly over the print.

settings.question: Do you do custom orders?
settings.answer: Sometimes! Reach out via email with your idea. Bulk orders of 10+ for events or groups are welcome.

settings.question: What if my size is sold out?
settings.answer: Use the Notify Me button and we'll alert you when it's back in stock.

settings.question: Where are you based?
settings.answer: A Hayley Original is an Australian brand. Orders are fulfilled globally by Printful from the facility closest to you.
